extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
The Dominaria United Set Booster contains 12Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token/ad card or card from “The List” (a special card from Magic's history—found in 25% of packs).
Contents:
• 12 Magic: The Gathering cards per booster
• Best MTG booster to open just for fun
• 1–4 cards of rarity Rare or higher in every pack
• At least 1 Legendary Creature and 1 Traditional Foil card in every pack • Return to Magic’s home plane in a set full of your favorite MTG legends and heroes
